# Auto-generated compliance vector catalog.
# One requirement per line; format: <source-L-doc>: <description>

L10: Line reset — drive ≥ 50 SWCLK cycles with SWDIO=HIGH from each state; verify SW-DP returns to Idle.
L10: IDCODE/DPIDR readback — verify ACK=OK + 32-bit DPIDR with bit 0 = 1.
L10: Request packet parity — corrupted-parity Request shall be ignored or set WDATAERR.
L10: Request Start/Stop/Park — verify Start=0, Stop=1, Park=0 each ignored.
L10: ACK code validation — verify only OK=001 / WAIT=010 / FAULT=100.
L10: Data parity on read — verify the 33rd bit = even parity of 32 data bits.
L10: Data parity on write — bad parity → WDATAERR → FAULT → clear via ABORT.WDERRCLR.
L10: Turnaround — verify 1-cycle default and 4-cycle max.
L10: ABORT register — verify each clear bit clears its CTRL/STAT counterpart.
L10: SELECT register — verify APSEL + APBANKSEL + DPBANKSEL route to correct AP/bank.
L10: RDBUFF — verify posted-read recovery.
L10: AP IDR readback — for each implemented AP, verify non-zero IDR.
L10: AP BASE readback — verify ROM Table base address + Present bit.
L10: MEM-AP TAR + DRW round-trip — write to RAM, read back, verify match.
L10: MEM-AP auto-increment Single — verify TAR += transfer size after each DRW.
L10: MEM-AP auto-increment Packed — multiple sub-word per DRW.
L10: MEM-AP 4K wrap-around — verify auto-increment wraps within 4 KB.
L10: WAIT retry — verify host can retry until OK.
L10: FAULT recovery — read CTRL/STAT, write ABORT, retry.
L10: Sticky overrun — many posted reads → STICKYORUN set; clear via ABORT.ORUNERRCLR.
L10: SWJ-DP JTAG-to-SWD selection — shift 0xE79E → SWD mode.
L10: SWJ-DP SWD-to-JTAG selection — shift 0xE73C → JTAG mode.
L10: Multi-drop SWD — TARGETSEL with matching TPARTNO+TINSTANCE addresses correct target.
L10: CDBGPWRUPREQ / CSYSPWRUPREQ — verify ack handshake.
L10: DAPABORT — verify in-flight AP transaction cancelled.
L10: DHCSR halt — write C_HALT=1 → CPU halts (S_HALT=1).
L10: DHCSR step — verify single-step.
L10: CoreSight ROM Table walk — host enumerates all components.
L10: Cortex-M debug entry — halt before first user-code instruction (DEMCR.VC_CORERESET).
L16: Two mandatory dedicated pins: SWCLK (host-driven) and SWDIO (bidirectional).
L16: Every transaction is exactly 46 bits: Request + Turnaround + ACK + Data + Parity + Turnaround.
L16: Request packet: Start=1, Stop=0, Park=1; Parity even over APnDP+RnW+A[2:3].
L16: ACK encoding: OK=001, WAIT=010, FAULT=100 (one-hot only).
L16: Data: 32 bits LSB first + 33rd parity bit (even parity).
L16: DPIDR register at A[3:2]=0x0 read; bit 0 hard-wired to 1 (RAO).
L16: ABORT register at A[3:2]=0x0 write; supports DAPABORT + STKCMPCLR + STKERRCLR + WDERRCLR + ORUNERRCLR.
L16: CTRL/STAT register at A[3:2]=0x4.
L16: SELECT register at A[3:2]=0x8 write; APSEL + APBANKSEL + DPBANKSEL fields.
L16: RDBUFF register at A[3:2]=0xC read.
L16: Up to 256 APs addressable via SELECT.APSEL.
L16: MEM-AP register catalog: CSW, TAR, DRW, CFG, BASE, IDR at minimum.
L16: MEM-AP IDR.Class = 8.
L16: Line reset = ≥ 50 consecutive SWCLK cycles with SWDIO=HIGH.
L16: Post-reset host first transaction is IDCODE/DPIDR read.
L16: Posted reads: data of read N returned with ACK of read N+1; final via DP.RDBUFF.
